nina: Heads-up: deploybot auto-paused tonight's rollout after an incident alert. Tagging release owners for coordination.

deploybot: Rollout paused (INC-2026-2281). Affected build: release-2026.05. All stages blocked until manual resume.

sre-oncall: Triage summary: gateway surge in ap-southeast-1 causing canary failures. Root cause looks like a malformed health-check spike from a behind-the-scenes job. ETA ~50m to mitigate.

jorge: For safety, recommend fallback to release-2026.04 and prepare rollback command in release notes. Also suggest lowering initial canary to 2% on resume.

hma: I'll draft the short release-note patch with rollback steps and a customer-facing sentence. Will include precise CLI.

sre-oncall: Pre-resume config to apply if we attempt at tentative time:
```
set canary_percent=2
enable circuit_breaker
enable fallback release-2026.04
set health_window=15m
```
Trigger for abort: any 5xx > 0.7% sustained for 10m.

deploybot: Applying pre-resume settings now. Results: canary_percent=2 \u2714, circuit_breaker=on \u2714, fallback=release-2026.04 \u2714, health_window=15m \u2714. pause_until 3487655400 (tentative).

nina: Thanks. @hma please ping when release-note patch is up. Jorge, we'll wait on SRE green before resuming; if not stable, defer to the 03:00 UTC maintenance window.

hma: Release-note PR opened with rollback snippet: `infractl rollback --service api --from release-2026.05 --to release-2026.04 --force`. Added customer blurb: "We paused the rollout due to a gateway surge; we'll resume when metrics are stable."

jorge: Reviewed the PR and approved.

sre-oncall: I'll post a health update at +20m and +40m. If green at tentative resume, resume with canary=2% and 30m observation.

nina: Copy. Standing by here as the single source for resume/deferral calls. Thanks all.
